headline: High Court Rules Uber Owes $81 Million in NSW Payroll Tax
summary: The High Court of Australia determined that rideshare company Uber owes payroll tax in New South Wales, amounting to $81 million.
why: Judicial rulings regarding contractor classifications and payroll tax liabilities for gig-economy platforms carry substantial precedent for employment law and corporate tax obligations.

impacts.name: Uber Technologies
impacts.why: An unexpected retroactive tax bill creates an immediate financial liability and alters operational cost models for gig platforms.
